consequence.statement: After upgrading to Argo CD 3.0.0, Argo CD's kubectl-based operations run with the newly bundled kubectl 1.32.1 instead of the previously bundled kubectl version.
consequence.remediation: Review whether kubectl 1.32.1 is compatible with the Kubernetes versions of the clusters this Argo CD manages.

assertion.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0 upgrades the kubectl it uses to version 1.32.1.
